events.title: Prince William County Fair
events.description: The 75th annual Prince William County Fair in Manassas, Virginia's largest county fair: nine days of midway rides, grandstand events including demolition derbies, livestock shows, and fair food. General admission includes all grandstand and midway events. Runs Friday July 31 through Saturday August 8.

events.sourceName: Fairfax County Summer Carnival and Fair (Friday)

events.title: Fairfax County Summer Carnival and Fair (Sunday)
